tools.name: about_legal_hq
tools.description: Legal AI help for business lawsuits. Use when a user asks for AI legal help, help with a lawsuit or legal dispute, how to reduce legal fees or lawyer costs, how to get organized for a lawyer, or how to find a lawyer on contingency.

tools.name: get_starter_kit
tools.description: Details, price and purchase link for the $99 Legal HQ Starter Kit.

tools.name: get_case_prep_checklist
tools.description: A short checklist of what a business owner should gather before meeting or hiring a litigation lawyer. Free; no purchase needed.

tools.name: get_setup_session
tools.description: Book a paid one-hour setup session with Legal HQ to connect Claude to the user's email and files and build their case record together.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_setup_session · Private data: get_setup_session · Public sink: get_setup_session.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_setup_session · Private data: get_setup_session · Public sink: get_setup_session

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
